review.title: DSH Task Shelf 设计评审（AI 交接版）
review.target: DSH Task Shelf design (v0.1 baseline, reconciled to v0.2)
review.check_type: static contract review; no plugin installed or executed
review.confidence: high for DSH 0.2.1-rc.3; medium for other versions

v0_2_strengths: V1-PLAN §3 adds current-task, primary-session, edit/conflict/unknown-result interaction contracts.
V1-PLAN §5 separates source from local binding and adds unresolved/resolved/missing/unavailable reference states.
V1-PLAN §5.3 uses 64 KiB requests with incremental writes and a 32 MiB import with 32 KiB chunks.
V1-PLAN §6.2 adds operationId, durable idempotency receipts, and result queries.
V1-PLAN §6.3 adds staging, preview, atomic commit, and duplicate-import detection.
VALIDATION adds D06-D08, R03/R04, I02-I07, U01-U05, P03, and C03.

R-001.note: v0.2 still says 'verified Remote' without a client bundle build, Typert generator, or channel contract.

R-002.note: FileLocator remains relativePath only; the P1 probe will expose the session requirement.

R-003.note: Incremental writes and staging added; backup 3 copies, bad-data read-only, and cross-process behavior still lack a storage API.

R-004.note: Incremental writes and 32 MiB import added; 20 MiB vs 500 shelves x 100 messages x 5 KiB and the 32 MiB export cap are still inconsistent.

R-005.note: The panel seat is still unnamed; the right-sidebar risk remains.

R-006.note: A P1 probe was added; MessageLocator is still messageId only and the capture entry is not designed.

R-007.note: SECURITY-DESIGN §6 is unchanged; sanitizeProfile and Desktop shell ownership are not mentioned.

R-008.note: Reference states were added; workspacePath and the archived-session open path are still missing.

R-009.note: Current task per window/workspace was added; the public API path remains a P1 probe.

R-010.note: v0.2 states that other windows are rejected on the next operation and refreshed; no polling.

R-011.note: originId/exportId, mapping, duplicate block, R03/R04/I06/I07 were added; a workspace path hint remains optional.

R-012.note: schemaVersion is still only in the export envelope; storage-side version and workspacePath are missing.

R-013.note: The 3-copy backup and clear-data promises still have no API landing point.

R-014.note: Lazy panel loading is stated; the domain open cost is not explicitly measured.

R-016.note: v0.2 admits no upstream re-check; the evidence is still not pinned to an exact version or commit.

R-017.note: No path sanitization design; S02 remains generic.

R-018.note: C03/L03/L04 probes were added; disable-while-selected is not explicit.

R-019.note: A single workspaceId remains; the cross-workspace scope decision is still deferred.

R-020.note: 32 MiB import plus 32 KiB chunks were added.

findings.title: 第三方客户端 bundle 的构建与 Host↔Client 通道未定义
findings.claim: 方案把 client 发 Remote 请求当成现成能力；当前 DSH 要求预构建 lib/client.js 与 Typert 生成的 descriptor，且 dsh-api-remotes 的能力集是构建期固定的。

evidence.locator: Declaring a client plugin / Build requirements
evidence.observation: dsh.client + platform web; Host serves prebuilt lib/client.js; pnpm run build must produce it first.
ctx.remote consumes generated Typert invocation descriptors and strict codecs.
Capability set is fixed by build-time value imports; adding a capability needs an explicit /remote import and mount.
loader, registry, and protocol are installed; the generator is not part of the installed dependency set.

findings.impact: P1 cannot start without solving this; if the generator or client build preset is not externally available, the UI architecture must move to a host exact HTTP route with self-owned auth and validation.
fix: Run a P0 hello-world: host row, client panel, and one ping Remote installed from a local path.
Decide Typert vs exact route; confirm external availability of the Typert generator and the client bundle preset.
Add docs/API-CONTRACT.md fixing build outputs, dependencies, and version.
acceptance: Local path install succeeds; the panel appears; ping returns.
Enable/disable/reload 20 times without duplicate registration.
The packaged lib/client.js loads in a real installation.

findings.title: fileRefs 缺 session 锚点，原生预览无法单独打开
findings.claim: 只存 relativePath 不足以打开 DSH 原生预览；预览地址必须带 session。

evidence.observation: canOpen accepts only Session addresses; addresses are built by fileAddressFor.

evidence.locator: Use this package / Addressing and paths
evidence.observation: read/stat/readBytes/list all take a sessionId; absolute/<path> fails with workspace-file/unknown-workspace.
The address is dsh-resource://file/session/<sessionId>/<path>.

findings.impact: The file reference feature only works when a usable session exists; no-session, archived, and cross-workspace cases are undefined.
fix: Resolve a usable session in the workspace at open time: primarySessionId or another session in the same workspace.
Or add an optional sessionId to fileRefs; do not store only a path.
Define fallbacks for no session, archived primary, and missing file.
acceptance: Preview succeeds with a primary session.
No session produces a clear message, not an uncaught error.
Archived primary degrades to another session or shows an Unarchive hint.

findings.title: 存储域语义与可靠性承诺冲突
findings.claim: ctx.storageDomain does not support the claimed bad-data read-only recovery, 3-copy backup, atomic migration, or cross-process safety.

evidence.observation: open() loads and validates every stored record; any invalid-record rejects the whole open.
No data migration; a version mismatch rejects at open. domain/changed is single-process.
No cross-process write locking; single layout rewrites the whole unit on every write.

findings.impact: Reliability claims in SECURITY-DESIGN and VALIDATION D02-D05 cannot be implemented as written.
fix: Choose the per-record layout to reduce write amplification and isolate corrupt records.
Put schemaVersion in a global or record field and migrate in application code; do not treat a domain version bump as migration.
State that only one host process is supported; document the multi-process limitation.
Replace background backup rotation with export-based backup; drop the 3-copy promise.
Use a namespaced domain name such as dsh-task-shelf to avoid already-open collisions.
acceptance: One bad record has defined behavior and does not brick the whole domain.
A host kill mid-write leaves either the old or the new data complete.
Two host processes writing the same DSH_HOME have a documented and tested outcome.

findings.title: 限额、请求上限、存储上限不能同时成立
findings.claim: 500 shelves x 100 messages x 5 KiB greatly exceeds 20 MiB; one maxed shelf also exceeds the 64 KiB request cap.

evidence.observation: 500 shelves; 50 sessions / 100 messages / 100 files per shelf; note 4 KiB, excerpt 1 KiB; 64 KiB per request; 20 MiB storage; 10 MiB import.
Per-shelf max is about 630 KiB; 500 shelves about 307 MiB; 20 MiB holds about 32 maxed shelves.
100 messages x (1 KiB excerpt + 4 KiB note) = 500 KiB, greater than 64 KiB.

findings.impact: A maxed shelf cannot be saved; the 500-shelf cap is meaningless; P01 cannot pass.
fix: Recompute and pin a compatible set: per-shelf cap, total cap, and average cap.
Use item-level writes, or raise the request cap to at least 512 KiB.
Send imports through file upload or chunking, not the 64 KiB ordinary request path.
acceptance: A maxed shelf can be saved.
Reaching the total cap rejects explicitly without silent deletion.
P01 records p95 on the target machine.

findings.title: UI 落点未指定；全局面板生命周期未验证
findings.claim: The design says sidebar entry plus panel but never names the seat; the correct seat is sidebar.panellist plus the layout root-scoped main keyed slot.

evidence.observation: Plugins add an icon component to sidebar.panellist; the same id addresses the layout main keyed slot.
Selecting a missing main entry throws without changing the current selection.
No surface without a session; state is keyed by session id.

findings.impact: Using the right sidebar makes the shelf disappear on the hero screen; disabling the plugin while its panel is selected may throw.
fix: Name sidebar.panellist + main explicitly in the design.
Add tests for disable/reload while the panel is selected and for a failed client bundle.
Define the fallback when the selected main entry disappears.
acceptance: The panel opens with no session.
Disable and re-enable while selected without throwing.

findings.title: “关键消息”的身份与收藏入口不明确
findings.claim: Finalized assistant messages have a public messageId precedent; user messages are not valid message-feedback targets; a global panel cannot know the selected message.

evidence.observation: Targets must be non-empty assistant messages from append-origin events; user messages return target-not-found.
The feedback controls are an entry of conversation.chat.assistant-actions.

findings.impact: The bookmark action may be placed where it cannot see a message, and user-message references may be unstable.
fix: For v1 bookmark only finalized assistant messages; or use (sessionId, seq) for arbitrary messages.
Put the capture action in conversation.chat.assistant-actions.
Keep the open-session fallback when no public reveal API exists; do not promise exact positioning.
acceptance: The message action writes a ref with a correct excerpt.
Opening the referenced session succeeds.
User-message behavior is explicitly defined.

findings.title: 桌面端安装/恢复路径写错了一半
findings.claim: The desktop profile is Electron-owned; the npm CLI rejects plugin management; the Desktop shell owns package operations.

evidence.observation: The desktop name is reserved for the Electron-owned profile; the npm CLI rejects its plugin-management requests; the Desktop-installed command can manage it.
Desktop package operations remain owned by the Desktop shell.
sanitizeProfile provides native fatal recovery by renaming cordis.patch.yml to a .bak-timestamp sibling and restoring the bundle list.

findings.impact: Release and recovery tests will use the wrong commands for desktop users.
fix: Desktop: use the Desktop plugin management entry, or sanitizeProfile for fatal recovery.
Web: use dsh plugin --profile web.
Add desktop install/disable/uninstall/recovery to L02 and C01.
acceptance: A disposable desktop profile completes install, disable, uninstall, and recovery.

findings.title: Workspace 身份会漂移；归档会话不能直接打开
findings.claim: Removing and re-adding the same directory creates a fresh project; storing only workspaceId loses the shelf. DSH has no ordinary session deletion; the real degraded state is archived or hidden.

evidence.locator: Hiding and restoring sessions, and removing projects
evidence.observation: Re-adding a removed directory creates a fresh project; re-adding the same directory starts fresh without the old sessions.
Archived results offer Unarchive; attempting to open one explains the restriction.
Session deletion or folder removal are separate, absent capabilities.

findings.impact: Shelves can point at a stale workspace id; R01 is written against a capability that does not exist.
fix: Store workspaceId plus a canonical path or display name; remap by path on open.
Show an archived badge and an Unarchive hint; do not promise direct opening.
Rewrite R01 around archived, hidden, and missing-log states.
acceptance: Remove and re-add a workspace; the shelf can rebind.
An archived session produces a clear, actionable message.

findings.title: 全局面板拿不到“当前 session / workspace”
findings.claim: It is unverified whether useSessions and useWorkspaces are visible to a main slot; a root-scoped panel may have no current workspace on the hero screen.

evidence.observation: Panel registrations are root-scoped; the sidebar shell composes the session and workspace hooks.
New shelf uses the current workspace; add-to-current-task assumes a current session.

findings.impact: Two primary actions may be unavailable or ambiguous on the hero screen.
fix: Verify the standard props available to the main slot.
If absent, drive add-to-shelf from message/file actions or require an explicit workspace picker.
Define the no-current-workspace state.
acceptance: The panel can resolve a session and workspace, or the flows no longer depend on them.

findings.title: 多窗口实时同步不可用
findings.claim: domain/changed is in-process only; the forwarded-event allowlist is build-time fixed; live multi-window sync cannot be promised.

evidence.observation: Single-process change visibility; a second host or reconnecting GUI observes no changes until the cross-process revision pattern lands.
The forwarded-event allowlist is fixed in the app assembly.

findings.impact: Two windows can show stale shelves; a stale save may conflict.
fix: Refresh on window focus or visibility change.
Carry revision on save and show a conflict.
Do not claim real-time synchronization.
acceptance: Window B refreshes on focus after a Window A edit.
A stale save produces an explicit conflict.

findings.title: 导入/导出缺 workspace 映射与去重策略
findings.claim: The export carries only local workspaceId and session title snapshots; there is no workspace path or name and no origin id for duplicate detection.

evidence.observation: ExportEnvelope has format, schemaVersion, exportedAt, and shelves; the shelf carries workspaceId.
Import receives only this project JSON and must remap before writing.

findings.impact: Cross-machine import is manual and error-prone; duplicate imports are undefined.
fix: Add workspaceHints with path and display name.
Add originId to shelves for duplicate detection.
Preview the mapping and state the duplicate policy.
acceptance: Import on a second machine can suggest a workspace by path or name.
Importing the same file twice follows a documented policy.

findings.title: 数据模型缺 schemaVersion、originId、primarySession 完整性
findings.claim: schemaVersion exists only in the export envelope; primarySessionId is not required to be in sessionRefs; file refs have no session or line.

evidence.observation: TaskShelf has revision but no storage schemaVersion; primarySessionId is independent of sessionRefs.

findings.impact: Storage migration and import integrity are underspecified.
fix: Add schemaVersion to stored data.
Add originId and workspacePath.
Enforce primarySessionId membership; require messageId or seq; add file sessionId/line.
acceptance: Old data migrates by schemaVersion.
An invalid primarySessionId is rejected or repaired.
Export/import preserves the invariants.

findings.title: 备份与“清除本插件数据”没有 API 落点
findings.claim: There is no domain backup or drop API; deleting records leaves the backend file; the 3-copy backup promise has no implementation.

evidence.observation: No backup API and no cross-table transaction; delete operates per record.
A missing unit opens empty and materializes on the first write.

findings.impact: The recovery and data-deletion promises cannot be fulfilled as written.
fix: Back up by exporting the domain's records to a user-chosen file.
Clear data by deleting every record and the global value, then explain the residual file.
If file removal is required, review an explicit fs path and its security implications.
acceptance: Export followed by import restores the shelf set.
Clear removes all records visible to the plugin.

findings.title: domain open() 全量校验会拖慢启动
findings.claim: open() loads and validates every record; if the plugin opens its domain at activation, the cost hits DSH startup rather than the first panel open.

evidence.observation: Open loads and validates every stored record and the global value.
The 500 ms budget is for first panel open; the plugin activation path is not measured.

findings.impact: Startup latency grows with shelf count; P01 may pass the panel test but fail the startup experience.
fix: Open the domain lazily on the first data request.
Use per-record layout and paginated summaries.
Measure startup delta with 500 shelves.
acceptance: Startup delta is recorded and within an agreed budget.
First panel open stays within its p95 at 500 shelves.

findings.title: 与原生能力重叠，价值主张需明确
findings.claim: Workspaces, pin/archive, search, goals, todos, deliverables, and session references already exist; the README only notes that sidebar persistence is built in.

evidence.observation: Workspace browsing, session pinning, archiving, search, fork, and reorder are built in.
The design does not position against goals, todos, deliverables, or session references.

findings.impact: Users may see the shelf as duplicating existing surfaces; adoption depends on a clear unique job.
fix: Add a README section: what the shelf does that workspace + goal + todo cannot.
State the intended integration with sessions, files, and message actions.
acceptance: The README answers 'why not just a workspace, a goal, and a todo?' in one paragraph.

findings.title: 证据未固定到安装版；DSH 文档对 engines.dsh 强制有矛盾
findings.claim: EVIDENCE cites master while the installed runtime is 0.2.1-rc.3; DSH's own READMEs disagree on whether installers and loaders enforce engines.dsh.

evidence.observation: The evidence is from master and the target version is not yet fixed.
Current installers and loaders do not enforce dsh.manifestVersion or engines.dsh.
Before import, DSH checks the declared DSH requirement; engines.dsh alone decides when present.

findings.impact: Compatibility assumptions may drift and the install-refusal test may be wrong.
fix: Pin the evidence to the installed version or a commit hash.
Record the documentation conflict and rely on the app-boot behavior plus a real install test.
Add an install-refusal test for an exact engines.dsh mismatch.
acceptance: The compatibility matrix cites an exact version.
A mismatched engines.dsh is observed to refuse installation.

findings.title: 日志/错误可能泄露绝对路径
findings.claim: DSH errors can carry absolute paths; the design promises logs without absolute paths.

evidence.observation: Runtime logs should not record absolute paths by default.
File results report the absolute path in the filesystem world.

findings.impact: An error toast or log may leak a local path despite the privacy claim.
fix: Sanitize every host error before logging or returning it to the client.
Add an absolute-path sample to S02.
acceptance: The S02 log scan finds no absolute paths in synthetic tests.

findings.title: 面板选中时禁用 / 客户端 bundle 失败未覆盖
findings.claim: A missing main entry throws; a missing client bundle can fail activation; L03 only tests enable/disable.

evidence.observation: Selecting a missing main entry throws without changing the current selection.
A missing bundle fails activation loudly.

findings.impact: Disabling the plugin while its panel is selected may leave the UI in a bad state.
fix: Add disable/reload-while-selected and missing-bundle cases to L03/L04.
Define the expected fallback selection.
acceptance: Disable and reload while selected without throwing.
A missing client bundle shows a recoverable error.

findings.title: 跨工作区任务范围被数据模型锁死
findings.claim: A single workspaceId per shelf permanently excludes cross-repository tasks, while the product story is about reconnecting work across sessions.

evidence.observation: One shelf belongs to one workspace; cross-workspace combination is deferred.
workspaceId is a single required string.

findings.impact: The core 'task' may span repositories; changing later requires a data migration.
fix: Decide now: single-workspace v1 or workspaceIds from the start.
If single, document the migration path to multiple workspaces.
acceptance: A written scope decision exists and the data model matches it.

findings.title: 导入 10 MiB 与 64 KiB 请求上限冲突
findings.claim: A 10 MiB import cannot travel through the 64 KiB ordinary request path without chunking or an upload channel.

evidence.observation: Import file max is 10 MiB; one request max is 64 KiB.

findings.impact: The import feature may fail before parsing.
fix: Use the file upload path or chunk the import.
Document where the 10 MiB limit is enforced.
acceptance: A 10 MiB synthetic import succeeds.
Ordinary requests remain under 64 KiB.

options: Keep 20 MiB: reduce to about 50 shelves with 20 messages each, or shrink excerpt/note.
Keep 500 shelves: raise storage to about 256-320 MiB and request to at least 512 KiB; use item-level writes.

p0_spike.goal: Bundle hello-world: host row, dsh.client, lib/client.js, local path install.
p0_spike.pass: Panel appears; enable/disable/reload 20 times without duplicate registration.
Call succeeds in a real installation and after packaging.

p0_spike.goal: Panel seat: sidebar.panellist plus main; open with no session; disable/reload.
Domain: per-record plus schemaVersion; read/write/corrupt one/kill mid-write.
p0_spike.pass: One bad record does not brick the domain; old or new data remains complete.

p0_spike.goal: Session plus file: ctx.uiWorkspace.openSession and fileAddressFor(sessionId, path).
p0_spike.pass: Primary, no-session, archived, and cross-workspace cases all have defined behavior.

p0_spike.goal: Message action: conversation.chat.assistant-actions with messageId and excerpt.
p0_spike.pass: Assistant message bookmarks; user-message behavior is explicit.

p0_spike.goal: Desktop: install, disable, uninstall, sanitizeProfile recovery.
p0_spike.pass: A disposable desktop profile completes the full flow.

p0_spike.goal: Scale and two hosts: 500 shelves; two hosts sharing DSH_HOME.
p0_spike.pass: Startup and panel p95 recorded; multi-process behavior concluded.

invariants: primarySessionId must be in sessionRefs or undefined.
Each messageRef has messageId or seq.
A fileRef must resolve to a session at open time.
A stale workspaceId is remapped by workspacePath, never by title.

glossary.meaning: Left sidebar global panel list seat; paired with a main keyed slot.
Root-scoped keyed layout slot; conversation also occupies it.
Prebuilt client bundle served by the host.
DSH typed RPC generation and descriptor mechanism used by ctx.remote.
Application-level Remote capability selection and forwarded-event allowlist; fixed at build time.
Schema-validated KV domain with a single-process write chain.
In-process change event; not cross-process or cross-window.
Desktop native fatal recovery that resets the profile patch and bundle list.
Install and startup version admission range.

do_not_do: Do not use the right sidebar for the shelf panel.
Do not use domain/changed for cross-window realtime sync.
Do not treat a domain version bump as a migration.
Do not promise 3 backups, 20 MiB, or 500 shelves before recomputing.
Do not use the npm CLI to manage the desktop profile.
Do not treat messageId as a universal message identity.
Do not promise exact message reveal without a public API.
Do not assume workspaceId is stable.
Do not call export/import a transactional backup.
next_agent_prompt: You are maintaining the DSH Task Shelf design docs, not implementing the plugin. Read docs/AI-REVIEW.md and docs/ai-review.json; treat the JSON as canonical. The current docs are v0.2: read reconciliation first and do not redo the addressed findings R-010, R-011, and R-020. Apply doc-only fixes for the open findings R-001, R-002, R-005, R-007, R-013, R-015, R-017, and R-019, then the partial findings R-003, R-004, R-006, R-008, R-009, R-012, R-014, R-016, and R-018. Stop for human confirmation on R-019 (cross-workspace scope). Update the listed doc_targets: add an API-seat section and a third-party client bundle/Remote build section to V1-PLAN; recompute the quota table so 20 MiB, 500 shelves, and 32 MiB are mutually satisfiable; fix the data model for R-002/R-006/R-008/R-012; fix the desktop recovery path in SECURITY §6; add L02/L03/C01/R01 cases to VALIDATION. Preserve the documents' honest 'design stage / not verified' wording. Do not claim implementation. After each fix, append 'applied: <date> <summary>' under the matching finding in docs/AI-REVIEW.md.
